name: user_initial
description: First user turn: ask the model to invent a factor from scratch at research date T_n.
template: Invent ONE novel factor for a basket of $n_symbols $asset_class instruments.
You are standing at $tn and may optimise on data from $is_start to $tn.
Prefer factors with a clear economic rationale.
Format example (this only shows the FORMAT; invent a different factor):
"rationale": "stable low-vol names outperform over one month",
"mechanism": "risk premia compensation, not a momentum bet",
